purpose: Evaluate the semantic relevance quality of the book recommender using the calibrated semantic-relevance judge as the measurement instrument. This evaluates the recommender, not judge-vs-human agreement.

measurement_instrument.qualification_note: Judge qualification is a separate lifecycle. This system evaluation consumes only judge scores.

system_under_test.reason_for_isolation: The first benchmark isolates semantic retrieval quality. Category filtering and emotional-tone ranking are separate behaviors and should receive separate evaluation dimensions.

benchmark.query_source: The 12 frozen semantic queries from facet spec v0.10.1.

primary_metrics.macro_mean_relevance_at_10: For each query, average its 10 judge scores; then average equally across the 12 queries.
primary_metrics.clear_or_strong_rate_at_10: Fraction of returned books with judge_score >= 3.
primary_metrics.irrelevant_rate_at_10: Fraction of returned books with judge_score == 0.
primary_metrics.hit_rate_at_5_clear_or_strong: Fraction of queries having at least one score >= 3 in ranks 1-5.
primary_metrics.top1_clear_or_strong_rate: Fraction of queries whose rank-1 recommendation has score >= 3.
primary_metrics.mrr_at_10_clear_or_strong: Mean reciprocal rank of the first score >= 3, or 0 if none.
primary_metrics.ndcg_at_10: Mean graded nDCG@10 using gain 2^score - 1. The ideal ranking is the same returned 10 books sorted by judge score.
primary_metrics.catastrophic_query_rate: Fraction of queries whose mean top-10 relevance is < 1.5.

statistical_uncertainty.method: query-level cluster bootstrap percentile confidence interval
statistical_uncertainty.rationale: Recommendations within one query are correlated. Resampling individual query-book pairs would understate uncertainty. Each bootstrap sample resamples the 12 query blocks with replacement and carries each query's complete ranked list with it.
statistical_uncertainty.interpretation_warning: Only 12 independent query clusters are present, so confidence intervals may be wide. This is appropriate for an interview benchmark but should be expanded before production qualification.

macro_mean_relevance_at_10_ge_2_50.rationale: Average recommendation quality should lie at least halfway between partial (2) and clear (3).

macro_mean_relevance_ci_lower_ge_2_00.rationale: Even the lower 95% confidence bound should remain at least partial relevance on average.

clear_or_strong_rate_at_10_ge_0_60.rationale: At least 60% of displayed recommendations should be clear or strong matches.

irrelevant_rate_at_10_le_0_10.rationale: No more than 10% of displayed recommendations should be complete misses.

hit_rate_at_5_clear_or_strong_ge_0_90.rationale: Almost every query should surface at least one clear/strong match in the first five.

top1_clear_or_strong_rate_ge_0_75.rationale: The first result should be clear/strong for at least 9 of 12 queries.

ndcg_at_10_ge_0_85.rationale: The returned list should place higher-relevance books near the top.

catastrophic_query_rate_eq_0.rationale: No benchmark query should have mean top-10 relevance below 1.5.

decision_policy.REVIEW: One or two gates fail and catastrophic_query_rate remains 0.
decision_policy.FAIL: Three or more gates fail, or catastrophic_query_rate > 0.
